MOBI.E is the national managing entity (EGME), not a seller. Driver bill = CEME (energy retailer/card) price per kWh/min/session + OPC (station operator) fee per kWh/min/session (set per charger, shown at station and on mobie.pt 'Encontrar Posto') + EGME tariff + IEC 0.001/kWh + network TAR; VAT 23% mainland (22% Madeira, 16% Azores) on total. EGME 2026: 0.1088 EUR per session for CEME and for OPC (2025: 0.1572; -30.8%, ERSE). Ad hoc card payment at station via service provider. OPC tariffs vary widely per charger; no consolidated official list on web
